**Job Title:**

Staff Nurse – ICU \& Inpatient Ward

**Job Type:**

Full\-time

**Location:**

VIJAYA MULTISPECIALITY HOSPITAL,TIRUPATHUR

**Experience Required:**

2–5 years in ICU and Inpatient Ward

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate **BSc Nursing graduate** with **1–3 years of hands\-on experience in ICU and IP (Inpatient) ward** settings to join our dynamic healthcare team. The ideal candidate should possess strong clinical skills, attention to detail, and a patient\-centered approach to nursing care.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide high\-quality nursing care to critically ill and inpatient patients
* Monitor patients’ conditions and report changes to the medical team
* Administer medications and manage IVs as per doctor's instructions
* Assist in emergency procedures and manage life\-saving equipment
* Maintain accurate patient records and documentation
* Ensure adherence to infection control protocols and hospital policies
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams for holistic patient care
* Provide emotional support to patients and their families

**Requirements:**

* B.Sc Nursing degree from a recognized institution
* Valid nursing registration with the relevant council
* 1–3 years of experience in ICU and/or Inpatient Ward
* Strong knowledge of critical care protocols and patient safety standards
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and handle emergencies

jobs.description:
**The core responsibility of a Commercial Broiler Branch Office In\-Charge is to oversee manage branch administration, and control operational costs.** In an integrated broiler management system,

* **Production Planning:** Coordinating chick placement schedules, monitoring specific batch intervals, and preparing the broiler houses before receiving fresh birds.

. Supply Chain \& Contractor Coordination

* **Input Procurement \& Logisitics:** Managing the on\-time delivery and stock levels of crucial raw materials, specifically balanced pre\-starter/starter/finisher feed rations, day\-old chicks, and vital litter material
* **Integration Coordination:** Acting as the primary point of contact for contract growers, ensuring they adhere to the company's approved grow\-out progra

Administration \& Data Reporting

* **KPI Tracking:** Utilizing farm management apps or system dashboards to record metrics like average daily weight gain, mortality rates, and daily feed consumption.
* **FCR Analysis:** Tracking Feed Conversion Ratios (FCR) meticulously to make certain that feed usage stays highly cost\-effective and within target limits.
* **Budgeting \& Reporting:** Preparing accurate performance logs and financial summaries for corporate evaluation to call out any deviations from expected growth targets

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Representative
jobs.description:
**Location**: Woodlux Furniture Zone

**Employment Type**: Full\-time

The Sales \& Marketing Representative is responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying new business opportunities, managing customer relationships, and executing marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and market penetration. This role combines direct sales activities with marketing coordination to achieve organizational targets.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales Responsibilities

* Identify, prospect, and develop new customers through field visits, calls, and digital channels
* Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to ensure repeat business
* Present, promote, and sell products/services using value\-based selling techniques
* Prepare and deliver sales quotations, proposals, and follow\-ups
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and close sales deals in line with company policies
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets
* Maintain accurate sales records, customer data, and pipeline updates in CRM systems

Marketing Responsibilities

* Support execution of marketing campaigns (digital, social media, print, exhibitions, events)
* Collect and analyze market intelligence, competitor activity, and customer feedback
* Assist in branding, promotions, and lead\-generation activities
* Coordinate with the marketing team to improve lead quality and conversion rates
* Represent the company at trade shows, exhibitions, and promotional events

Customer \& Internal Coordination

* Act as the primary point of contact for customers regarding inquiries and after\-sales coordination
* Coordinate with operations, accounts, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction
* Handle customer complaints professionally and ensure resolution

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to build long\-term client relationships
* Goal\-oriented with a strong sales mindset
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts and digital platforms
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and CRM tools
* Good time management and organizational skills

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* Relevant certifications in sales or digital marketing are an advantage

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in sales and/or marketing (industry\-specific experience preferred)
* Freshers with strong communication and learning ability may also be considered

Work Environment

* Field\-based and office\-based work
* May require local travel to meet clients and attend events

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Sales revenue and target achievement
* Number of new clients acquired
* Lead conversion rate
* Customer retention and satisfaction levels
* Effectiveness of marketing campaigns

jobs.title: Mechanical design engineer
jobs.description:
Mechanical Design Engineers utilize their expertise in engineering and mechanics to design, analyze and improve mechanical systems.

They are deeply involved in the development and manufacturing process, creating detailed designs and specifications for mechanical parts, assemblies, and systems using computer\-aided design (CAD) software.

Their duties and responsibilities often include:

* Designing and implementing cost\-effective equipment modifications to help improve safety, reliability and efficiency
* Developing project specifications by studying product design, customer requirements, and performance standards
* Performing detailed mathematical calculations to establish manufacturing and installation standards and specifications
* Inspecting and analyzing the performance of mechanical components, equipment and engines
* Assessing project requirements and researching to meet those requirements
* Ensuring a product can be made reliably and will perform consistently in specified operating environments
* Using computer\-aided design/modelling software
* Testing, evaluating, modifying and re\-testing products
* Writing reports and documentation
* Providing technical advice
* Overseeing the work of junior staff or mentoring engineers to improve their skills

Pay: ₹19,000\.00 \- ₹48,000\.00 per month
